Question
========
If a researcher concluded that there was no difference in police use of force against Black and White men when there actually is a difference, then:


Answerlist
----------

* The null hypothesis was incorrectly retained (false negative).

* The null hypothesis was incorrectly rejected (false positive).

* The null hypothesis was correctly rejected.

* The null hypothesis was correctly retained.
